shots.focal_element: Heavily defocused pale field with a soft dark-green blob rising at bottom centre
shots.transition_other: video start; no incoming transition (anchors give null)
shots.what_happens: A single 0.25 s opening frame: an out-of-focus pale backdrop with faint ghosted grid shapes and a blurred green form entering from the bottom edge, the first moment of the flower-stem growth that continues in s002.
shots.build_rebuild: Render a full-frame pale gradient with a radial dark-green blob at bottom centre under a heavy Gaussian blur (about 40px) and hold it for 3 frames before the stem grows.

shots.focal_element: A dark-green stem growing upward and a white circular bloom swelling into petals
shots.transition_other: continuous defocus-to-focus continuation of s001 (no visible cut)
shots.what_happens: On a lime backdrop a green stem rises from the bottom and a white disc grows on top of it, then multiplies into large overlapping soft-edged petals that fill the frame while the blur gradually reduces, reading as a flower blooming toward camera.
shots.build_rebuild: Animate a green rect stem scaleY 0 to 1 from the bottom, then scale a white circle from 0.2 to 1 and stagger five more white circles outward around it, all with a blur filter tweening from 30px to 8px over 1.8 s with ease-out.

shots.focal_element: The 'Light Guide' flower card, then the full Figma editor with the Motion timeline panel
shots.transition_other: continuous camera pull-out from the s002 bloom, which resolves into the centre card's flower illustration
shots.typography: Headline 'The Latest' and card titles in a light-weight serif, sentence/title case, normal tracking (guess: a Tiempos-like editorial serif, low confidence); small grey sans meta labels ('12 min'); Figma UI chrome in a small neutral sans (likely Figma's own UI font, low confidence).
shots.what_happens: The camera pulls out from the macro flower petals to reveal it as the centre card of a three-card 'The Latest' garden website, keeps pulling out to show the page inside the Figma editor (layers panel, Motion properties panel, timeline with Flower 1/Flower 2/Leaf 1A rotation and position tracks), then the editor floats as a framed window over a grainy lime/lavender textured background while the card illustrations animate (petals rotate, shapes shift) as the playhead scrubs.
shots.build_rebuild: Start with the centre card illustration at scale ~6 and tween the whole page container to scale 1 then to ~0.75 inside a Figma-editor mockup (left layers panel, right properties panel, bottom timeline with keyframe bars), placing it on a noise-textured backdrop, while looping per-card rotation keyframes and moving the timeline playhead linearly.

shots.focal_element: The product name 'Figma Motion' in large centred type
shots.typography: Product title in a regular-weight geometric/grotesque sans, title case, tight tracking, two stacked lines; first frame shows 'Figma' alone in light grey, then 'Motion' joins and the whole title turns orange. Card titles are heavy condensed uppercase sans with a highlighter-style background band (font names not identifiable).
shots.what_happens: On black, 'Figma' appears alone in grey, then 'Motion' is added beneath and the title switches to orange; around it a collage of animated tiles drifts in: a sliding carousel of event cards (left), a pixel-grid colour block and a dotted-halftone leaf image (top right), and a photo of translucent cubes with a lime node-graph shape (bottom). One counted event in this shot.
shots.build_rebuild: Center a two-line 64px-scale sans title on black, reveal 'Figma' first then append 'Motion' and tween colour grey to orange on the second word's entry, while four cropped media tiles slide in from the edges with staggered 0.1 s ease-out offsets and the left card strip scrolls horizontally inside a masked rounded panel.

shots.focal_element: A giant lavender pill shape on saturated violet, cropped at the right edge
shots.what_happens: A brief 0.58 s flat graphic: a huge lavender rounded-pill shape fills most of the frame on a violet background, a close-up that is revealed in s006 to be the track of a toggle switch.
shots.build_rebuild: Fill the frame with a violet background and a lavender pill (fully rounded left end) scaled ~2.5x so its right end is off-frame, holding for 7 frames before the pull-out.

shots.focal_element: A toggle-switch knob with a transform gizmo being dragged by an oversized cursor, above a timeline
shots.transition_other: continuous scale-down from the s005 pill, which becomes the toggle track (match on shape)
shots.typography: Only timeline tick numbers in a small regular neutral sans; no headline text.
shots.what_happens: The view scales down from the pill to reveal a toggle switch; a hand cursor grabs the knob inside a blue selection box, then an arrow cursor shows a transform gizmo (green up arrow, pink right arrow) and drags the knob to the right end of the track while a dotted motion path appears and a keyframe bar is created on the timeline below with the playhead near 0.7.
shots.build_rebuild: Draw a lavender pill toggle on violet with a dark-violet knob, overlay a two-axis gizmo and an oversized black cursor, tween the knob's x from left to right end with a dotted motion-path trail, and simultaneously grow a blue keyframe bar from 0 to the playhead on a cropped timeline strip at the bottom.
